en.title: Potential of the Player Who Wins k Games in a Row
en.description:
The two players at the front of the queue play a match; the one with greater potential stays at the front, and the loser goes to the back. The first player to win k games in a row wins; return that player's potential. All potentials are distinct.

The standard input/output format was compiled by this site; added numeric bounds and the encoding for no-solution cases are explicitly marked and do not claim to be the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n k, and the second line contains a permutation of potentials. 2≤n≤100000, potentials are distinct and in 1..n, 2≤k≤10^14.
hints: Scan the original queue, maintaining the current champion and its win streak; when the champion changes, the streak becomes 1. If the scan ends without reaching k, the global maximum potential is bound to win.
